f.rules.text: Some checkpoints block or utilize only Grapple, Shield Bounce, and/or Piledriver.
f.practice.title: Skip, go back, freemode
f.practice.text: Practice any checkpoint, or roam the map with the clock paused.
f.qol.title: Quality of life
f.qol.text: A cleaner HUD with easier menu controls. Hold to restart a checkpoint or your whole run, pause anytime and resume later, and get a bhop of grace on every checkpoint.
f.lobby.title: Lobby leaderboard
f.lobby.text: On the Ballkour remakes, the top 10 times hang in the lobby and the finish screen shows the time to beat.
f.beta.note: Try these with the Beta code of a Ballkour remake.
f.hints.title: Hints
f.hints.text: A recorded route shows you the way through. Turn hints on yourself, or they switch on after 10 mistakes on one checkpoint.
f.spectate.title: Spectate
f.spectate.text: Watch other runners in first or third person, or fly in freecam mode.
f.splits.title: Splits
f.splits.text: Best and average times for every checkpoint, plus a pace timer to see your estimated finish time.
f.scorecards.title: Scorecards
f.scorecards.text: See every runner’s checkpoint, time, and mistakes live, along with the lobby’s top 3.
f.qol.beta: Idle runners shrink so they never block your view. See your current run and attempt numbers, view each run’s video and date in the lobby, and toggle an FAQ for newcomers.
f.translations.text: Translated into 13 languages, so each player gets a similar experience in their own language.

faq.valid.q: What counts as a valid run?
faq.valid.a: Your run is only disqualified if you skip a checkpoint. Going back a checkpoint, restarting checkpoints, and spectating are allowed for legitimate runs. Leaving a checkpoint with freemode on counts as skipping it. Disqualified runs are <fg808080FF>grayed out</fg> on the scorecard.
faq.mistake.a: Landing anywhere but the next checkpoint, bhopping twice, missing a bounce checkpoint's bounce, dying, or leaving mid-attempt with Reset CP, Prev./Next CP, Lobby, Freemode or Spectate.
faq.timer.q: When does my run's timer start?
faq.timer.a: When you leave the first checkpoint, not when you spawn.
faq.pause.a: Lobby/Pause and Spectate stop your timer, and Resume Run in the lobby carries on from your checkpoint. Pausing away from your checkpoint counts as a mistake.
faq.freemode.a: Practice, with no timer and all your abilities. You can't clear checkpoints in it, and leaving your checkpoint with it on disqualifies your run.
faq.counts.q: What do Runs and Attempts count?
faq.counts.a: Runs counts the runs you've finished or restarted. Attempts counts your mistakes and clears on this checkpoint, over all your runs.
faq.attempt.q: What do Attempt and Split mean?
faq.attempt.a: Attempt is timed from leaving the checkpoint, and Split from reaching it, so it includes your mistakes. Each turns red once it's slower than your best. After a clear they show your times for 2 seconds: <fgFFFF00FF>yellow</fg> on your first clear, then <fg00E092FF>green</fg> if faster or <fgFF4646FF>red</fg> if slower than your average. A new best is compared with your old best.
faq.best.q: Are Best and Avg server records?
faq.best.a: No, they're only your own times on that checkpoint, over all your runs. They reset when you leave or the server restarts.
faq.pace.a: Your estimated finish time, from this run's average split so far. Once your current split is slower than that average, it turns <fgFF4646FF>red</fg> and counts up with your time.
faq.grayed.q: Why are some controls grayed out?
faq.grayed.a: They can't be used right now: Prev. CP on the first checkpoint, Next CP on the last, and the player controls while there's nobody to spectate. X-Hair Player also needs freecam.
faq.scorecard.a: Each runner's checkpoint, time and mistakes, furthest first, then fastest. <fg808080FF>Grayed out</fg> runs are disqualified.
faq.hints.q: What do the hint colors mean?
faq.hints.a: <fgCB87FFFF>Movement</fg> <fgFFFFFFFF>Jump</fg> <fgFFD200FF>Grapple</fg> <fgFF4646FF>Piledrive</fg> <fg00BEFFFF>Shield Bounce</fg> Hints turn on by themselves after 10 mistakes on one checkpoint, and off again when you move on to another.
faq.leaderboard.q: How do I get on the leaderboard?
faq.leaderboard.a: Finish a valid run and submit a video of it at ballkour.com. Lobby Top 3 only lists the fastest valid runs finished in this lobby.
faq.tiny.a: Players who haven't moved for 60 seconds shrink, so they're not in anyone's way. They grow back as soon as they move.
faq.restart.a: Yes, about every 4 hours, with warnings from 30 minutes before. Best, Avg, Runs and Attempts start over.
faq.language.q: Is something wrong in my language?
faq.language.a: The translations are drafts, so please report mistakes at ballkour.com/issues.
